Jun 18, 2024 • Less than a minute read

Paper accepted by MICCAI 2024 - *Enhancing Human-Computer Interaction in Chest X-ray Analysis using Vision and Language Model with Eye Gaze Patterns* - on [arxiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.02370)

Yunsoo and folk's paper on utilising eye gaze data for chext x-ray analysis has now been accepted by [MICCAI 2024](https://conferences.miccai.org/2024/en/).

Read the preprint version at [arXiv:2404.02370](https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.02370).
